label: Able to Lean on Each Other

lines.text: One morning...
As I get dressed and gather my things to go to work...
... Uh-oh.
... the room suddenly starts to spin.
I stagger and brace myself on the desk.
Whoa...
The dizziness gets worse.
Th-this...
isn't... good...
*Thud*
About an hour later...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Oh, look at you.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: We can't have you getting sick!

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: You've got class, remember? Hehe.
Sorry... I must've been a lot more stressed than I realized.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: You've survived getting holes put in you like it was nothing. How much stress have you been under exactly?!
Haha...
I'm lying down on my bed, being tended to by Arcana.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Are you stressed because of the students?
Kind of... but lately, I've just been wanting to do a lot better,
since now I've got someone watching over and supporting me.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Are you trying to make my heart race again?
Do you want me to stop?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I didn't say that.
Arcana smiles and holds out a spoon.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Here, have some chicken soup. Say ahh!
I'm really not hungry.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Uh-uh.
Arcana raises her finger as if scolding a puppy.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: You're not getting out of this. If you want to get better, you need to eat.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Now hurry up and say ahh.
... Like you said, I've survived getting holes put in me.
I'll be fine before you know... mph!
Arcana forcefully pushes the spoon into my mouth.
The taste is savory.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Why are you being so difficult today?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Now, chew the chicken.
Ish... hot!

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Hehe. What was that again?
I am semi-forced to finish the entire bowl of soup.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Good boy! Did you enjoy that?
Uh, Arcana...
Don't you think you're kinda treating me like a... kid, or... a pet?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Yup.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: It's my first time seeing you like this, and you're just so adorable.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Also, I'm kind of upset with you.
Upset?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: You promised me you wouldn't overdo it.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I was shocked when I heard you'd collapsed.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Do you know how worried I was?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: About as worried as I get when I'm waiting for you to come back from a mission to the surface.
Arcana's voice wavers slightly as she speaks, and I pull her in for an embrace.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Mr. {AccountData.NickName}...
Just when I think she's going to lean further into me, she pulls away.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: ... Hehe.
... Huh?
Her wistful expression suddenly turns playful,
and she lightly flicks my nose.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Were you just trying to seduce me right now?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Sorry, but that doesn't work anymore.
Er, no, that's not...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: It would be such a waste to ruin the perfect image you've built up.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: You know, I actually debated for a while whether visiting you would be okay or not.
I mean, visiting someone who's sick should be fine...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: You think just the two of us being alone in such a private, intimate space is fine?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Imagine another student or teacher seeing us like this.
Yeah, okay... Point taken.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Still, I came because I was worried.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: And yet here you are trying to flirt with me.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Are you sorry?
... Yes.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Good. Now...
Arcana kneels and pats her thighs.
Huh...?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Rest your head here.
*Rustle*

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Good boy.
Hold on, I... erk!
As I try to get up to protest, Arcana firmly presses my head down.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: There there, good boy.
I give up resisting and relax my body.
Arcana smiles in satisfaction and toys with my bangs.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: This is a first, isn't it?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Both in the Ark and at school,

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I've always been the one to rely on you,

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: and you've always been there for me to lean on.
That's true... This feels kinda weird.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Does it?
Yes.
I do have to ask, though...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Yes?
So hugging isn't okay, but having my head in your lap is?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: This is fine because... the actual area of contact is much smaller. Mm-hmm.
I don't think that's how it works.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Oh, it's fine!

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: The important thing is that I'm confident now.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: You could pin me against a wall and I would push you away without even blinking an eye.
Really?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: ... Okay, no, I'm not really that confident.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: But still, you promised you'd give me more compliments,

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: so long as I keep being a good student.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Are you uncomfortable?
I'm sleepy.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Hehe. Get some sleep.
If I sleep now, I'll be out for the whole day.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Then I'll stay with you for the whole day.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: What?
Nothing, it's just...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Are you worried I might get tired?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: You know...
Arcana gently strokes my head.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I want to be someone you can rely on too.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: You've been there for me as a commander, and now as a teacher...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I want to give you as much strength as you've given me. More, even.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Whether you're my teacher, or my commander...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I want to be someone you can lean on.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: ... Would that be okay?
... Thank you.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Thank you, too.
I slowly close my eyes.
Arcana continues to gently stroke my head.
Feeling safe and comforted,
I slowly drift to sleep.
I open my eyes and instinctively try to sit up.
Huh?!
*Thud*
Ow...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Ack!
In my haste, I hit my forehead on something and fall back down.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Wh-what's wrong?!
H-huh...?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: You were sound asleep and then suddenly jumped up. What happened?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Were you having a nightmare?
Arcana rubs my forehead.
Through the mental fog, my thoughts slowly come into focus.
I was asleep, huh...?
It feels like I only closed my eyes for a second... Wait...
I look at the clock, which has just passed 11:30.
It's 11:30... in the morning, right?
Arcana silently points at the window.
It's completely dark outside.
I slept for over twelve hours?!

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Yeah, you were really out. I had to check if you were still breathing.
And you had my head in your lap the entire time?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Of course.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I promised that I'd spend the day with you, didn't I?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: And anyway, it was... fun. Heh.
I-I see.
Aren't your legs numb, though?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: H-honestly, I can't feel them at all.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: ... L-let me try stretching one out.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Here goes...
We spend the next twenty minutes trying to restore the feeling to Arcana's legs.
... Can you feel both your legs now?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: It turns out that seeing someone else do a romantic gesture...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: ... is a lot different from doing it yourself.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Lesson learned, I suppose.
Y-yeah...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: What about you, Mr. {AccountData.NickName}?
Hm?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Are you feeling better?
Oh...
I lightly stretch my body.
I practically feel like I could fly.
Yeah. I'm fine now.
It's all thanks to you, Arcana.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Hehe. Is that so?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Does that mean you're going to give me another compliment? Or maybe a reward?
Is there anything specific that you want?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Hmm...
Arcana picks up her bag and stands up.
Wait, you're just going to leave?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I need to get going. It's late.
I follow Arcana toward the entrance to see her off.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Now that you're all better, I'll see you tomorrow.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: There's still some soup left, so make sure you finish it.
I will. See you tomorrow.
Arcana puts on her shoes.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: As for a reward... you don't have to give me anything.
Are you sure? No changing your mind later.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Hehe. I won't.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Wanna know why?
Arcana quietly looks at me.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: ... Because I already got my reward.
